expectedIssues: Bottom nav labels are cut off below the screen edge and the gesture bar overlaps the icons
reportedIssues: The device home indicator (horizontal gesture bar) is rendered directly on top of the bottom navigation bar, overlapping and partially obscuring the search icon in the center. This creates a visual collision and may interfere with tapping the search tab.
The notification bell icon in the top-right has a small red dot indicator with no accompanying label or badge count, which may be unclear to users relying on screen readers.

In the 'Fastest near you' row, the delivery-time pill badges sit at the bottom-left of each card image with inconsistent vertical alignment relative to the differing image backgrounds, giving a slightly uneven appearance across cards.
